"'''Moff Balfour's Lament (Tapmint Surprise)'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] about [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour]] by [[Deeply Religious]], from their album ''[[Emperor of Air and Darkness]]''. It was banned by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].
